get_presentation.label: Get Presentation
get_presentation.description: Get all slides from a presentation

presentation_id.label: Presentation ID
presentation_id.description: The presentation ID (between /d/ and /edit in its URL), or the full URL.

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: Optional Google field mask to return only part of the presentation, e.g. presentationId,title,slides(objectId). Leave empty for the full presentation.

generate_from_template.label: Generate from template
generate_from_template.description: Generate a new slide from a template

template_presentation_id.label: Template presentation ID
template_presentation_id.description: The template presentation ID (between /d/ and /edit in its URL), or the full URL.

placeholder_format.label: Placeholder Format
placeholder_format.description: Choose the format of placeholders in your template

folder_id.label: Folder
folder_id.description: Optional Drive folder for the new presentation: its ID or URL (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/<id>). Leave empty to use the default location. A service account needs a folder in a Shared Drive here.

create_presentation.label: Create Presentation
create_presentation.description: Create a new, empty Google Slides presentation, optionally in a Drive folder.

title.label: Title
title.description: Name of the new presentation, e.g. "Q3 Business Review".

folder_id.label: Folder
folder_id.description: Optional Drive folder: its ID or URL (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/<id>). Leave empty for My Drive. A service account needs a folder in a Shared Drive here.

copy_presentation.label: Copy Presentation
copy_presentation.description: Make a copy of a presentation, optionally with a new name and folder.

presentation_id.label: Presentation to Copy
presentation_id.description: The presentation ID or its full URL, e.g. https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1AbC...xyz/edit or just 1AbC...xyz.

name.label: New Name
name.description: Name of the copy. Leave empty for Google's default ("Copy of <name>").

folder_id.label: Folder
folder_id.description: Optional Drive folder for the copy: its ID or URL (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/<id>). Leave empty to use the default location. A service account needs a folder in a Shared Drive here.

insert_text.label: Insert Text
insert_text.description: Insert text into a shape, text box or table cell (appends by default).

presentation_id.label: Presentation
presentation_id.description: The presentation ID or its full URL, e.g. https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1AbC...xyz/edit or just 1AbC...xyz.

object_id.label: Element Object ID
object_id.description: Object ID of the shape, text box, placeholder or table, e.g. "g2c8d1e5a7f_0_3". Get it from List Slide Elements, Get Presentation Outline (elements[].objectId), or the output of Create Shape / Create Table. For a table also set Row and Column.

row.label: Row
row.description: Table cells only: row number, starting at 1. Leave empty for shapes and text boxes.

column.label: Column
column.description: Table cells only: column number, starting at 1. Leave empty for shapes and text boxes.

text.label: Text
text.description: The text to insert. Start it with \n to begin a new paragraph after the existing text.

insertion_index.label: Insertion Index
insertion_index.description: Optional 0-based character position (0 = start). Leave empty to append at the end.

set_element_text.label: Set Element Text
set_element_text.description: Replace all text in a shape, text box, placeholder or table cell.

presentation_id.label: Presentation
presentation_id.description: The presentation ID or its full URL, e.g. https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1AbC...xyz/edit or just 1AbC...xyz.

object_id.label: Element Object ID
object_id.description: Object ID of the shape, text box, placeholder or table, e.g. "g2c8d1e5a7f_0_3". Get it from List Slide Elements, Get Presentation Outline (elements[].objectId), or the output of Create Shape / Create Table. For a table also set Row and Column.

row.label: Row
row.description: Table cells only: row number, starting at 1. Leave empty for shapes and text boxes.

column.label: Column
column.description: Table cells only: column number, starting at 1. Leave empty for shapes and text boxes.

text.label: Text
text.description: The new text. Use \n for a new paragraph. Leave empty only together with Clear Text.

clear_text.label: Clear Text
clear_text.description: Turn on to remove all text from the element. Leave Text empty when using this.

update_paragraph_style.label: Update Paragraph Style
update_paragraph_style.description: Set alignment, line spacing, paragraph spacing and bullets in a shape or table cell.

presentation_id.label: Presentation
presentation_id.description: The presentation ID or its full URL, e.g. https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1AbC...xyz/edit or just 1AbC...xyz.

object_id.label: Element Object ID
object_id.description: Object ID of the shape, text box, placeholder or table, e.g. "g2c8d1e5a7f_0_3". Get it from List Slide Elements, Get Presentation Outline (elements[].objectId), or the output of Create Shape / Create Table. For a table also set Row and Column.

row.label: Row
row.description: Table cells only: row number, starting at 1. Leave empty for shapes and text boxes.

column.label: Column
column.description: Table cells only: column number, starting at 1. Leave empty for shapes and text boxes.

match_text.label: Match Text
match_text.description: Optional: only change every occurrence of this exact text (case-sensitive) inside the element. Leave empty (and Start/End Index empty) for all of its text.

start_index.label: Start Index
start_index.description: Optional 0-based start of a character range (instead of Match Text).

end_index.label: End Index
end_index.description: Optional 0-based end of the range, exclusive (instead of Match Text).

alignment.label: Alignment
alignment.description: START (left in left-to-right text), CENTER, END or JUSTIFIED.

line_spacing.label: Line Spacing (%)
line_spacing.description: Line spacing as a percentage of normal: 100 = single, 150 = one and a half.

space_above.label: Space Above (pt)
space_above.description: Space before each paragraph, in points.

space_below.label: Space Below (pt)
space_below.description: Space after each paragraph, in points.

bullets.label: Bullets
bullets.description: Bullet or numbering preset for the paragraphs, or NONE to remove bullets.

move_resize_element.label: Move or Resize Element
move_resize_element.description: Set the position and/or size of an element on a slide, in points.

presentation_id.label: Presentation
presentation_id.description: The presentation ID or its full URL, e.g. https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1AbC...xyz/edit or just 1AbC...xyz.

object_id.label: Element Object ID
object_id.description: Object ID of the element to move or resize (from List Slide Elements or Get Presentation Outline).

x.label: X (pt)
x.description: New distance from the left edge of the slide, in points.

y.label: Y (pt)
y.description: New distance from the top edge of the slide, in points.
